Canonical API specification for the IDSC Clinic System.

The Clinic System manages clinic-owned health records,
consultations, health statuses, and medicine dispensations.

Student identity and profile data are owned by the Registrar
System and consumed by Clinic through an integration service.

Medicine catalog, medicine stock, and stock transactions are
owned by the Inventory System and consumed by Clinic through
an integration service.

For the midterm implementation, external Registrar and Inventory
integrations may be represented by mock services while preserving
the same ownership and API boundaries intended for final integration.

## Local authentication workflow

This collection uses Django session-cookie authentication.

1. Run **Get CSRF token** first.
2. Its test script stores the returned token in `{{csrfToken}}`.
3. Run **Log in to the Clinic system**.
4. Postman retains the Django session cookie in its cookie jar.
5. Run protected Clinic API requests.
6. Run **Log out of the Clinic system** when finished.

`X-CSRFToken` is configured on login and logout because those operations
are CSRF-protected.

Optional query parameters are included as examples but disabled by default.
Enable only the filters needed for a request.

Resource identifiers are collection variables so IDs created during manual
testing can be updated without editing every request.
